source.title: Two incidents happened during inspection
source.content:
During inspection, a competitor reported that their timer was in 4-pad mode. As later discovered, the competitor touched their camera during the inspection violating [Regulation 2i2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i2b), before reporting the timer issue:

> 2i2b) The competitor must not interact with (e.g. operate, hold, wear) any active camera. Exception: the competitor may wear a camera mounted on their head, as long as it is out of their sight and it is clear that they are not interacting with it (apart from wearing it).

The WCA Delegates granted a provisional extra attempt, but the WRC agreed to **keep the DNF** since the competitor touched the camera **before** reporting the issue with the timer. In general, WRC considers the order in which incidents happen to determine the attempt's result (for example, if the competitor had reported the timer issue first, the extra attempt would have been used).

translation.title: 观察期间发生两起事件
translation.content:
观察时，选手报告计时器处于四触点模式。后来发现，在报告计时器问题之前，选手已在观察期间触碰摄像头，违反 [2i2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i2b)：
> 2i2b：不得与正在工作的摄像头互动，例如操作、手持、佩戴。例外是可佩戴在头部、处于视线之外，且除佩戴外明显没有互动的摄像头。

代表给予暂定的额外尝试，但 WRC 同意**保留 DNF**，因为选手在报告计时器问题**之前**已触碰摄像头。一般而言，WRC 根据事件先后顺序确定结果；例如若先报告计时器问题，则会采用额外尝试。
